text:
pagerbot: P0 ALERT — unusual outbound log delivery and auth anomalies detected. 401 spikes from 3 external CIDRs, and a telemetry sink shows several log batches POSTed to an unknown host (hxxp://54.23.11.9/upload). Severity: potential leaked logs + exposed tokens. Pager: @lia-oncall, @sre-alex, @maria-security. See alert: https://alerts.internal/alert/7321

sre-alex: on it. Observed same in proxy edge metrics. Dropping latency but 401s up 12x. starting triage, spinning incident-space now.

lia-oncall: joining. what services are showing POSTs?

maria-security: looks like the streaming-log-forwarder (svc-logfwd) sent 6 batches between 02:12-02:18 UTC to that IP. Payload size ~2.1MB each. Possible misconfigured drain target or creds exfil.

infra-ops: I'm slicing flow logs — giving us source nats and container ids. Blocking outbound to 54.23.11.9 on edge ACLs now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-firewall/block-egress-to-54.23.11.9 (by infra-ops) — 1/1 success.

lia-oncall: good. confirm that blocks are in place?

infra-ops: ACL applied across prod-edge in us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-west-1. No more egress to that IP.

cs-ken: parallel: any customers impacted? we have few active streams hitting svc-logfwd. Need quick list of tenants whose logs were in timeframe.

maria-security: running query: index=logs_forwarder src_time>=2026-03-15T02:10Z dst_ip=54.23.11.9 | top tenant_id. Preliminary: tenant_ids: t-98, t-501 (small), t-999 (dev). t-98 has sensitive error traces.

lia-oncall: okay, cs-ken please standby for customer notification draft. Legal @legal-paula — heads up, potential PII in logs; please advise on breach path and notif thresholds.

legal-paula: acknowledged. hold on customer comms until we know data classes. If PII, need 72hr notice window start timer. Also please preserve all artifacts.

maria-security: running internal artifacts preservation script and snapshotting the forwarder container:
```
./incident-preserve --service svc-logfwd --since 2026-03-15T02:00Z --out /incidents/1765439999/artifacts.tar.gz
```
Completed: artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: abcd1234...).

sre-alex: next: rotate service credentials for svc-logfwd and any stale forwarding tokens. Maria, can you confirm which keys were used in those POSTs?

maria-security: yes — header x-forwarder-token: svc-logfwd-prod-rot: token_id svc-logfwd-327. Appears active. I'll revoke token_id svc-logfwd-327 and issue replacement.

infra-ops: plan: 1) revoke token svc-logfwd-327 2) redeploy svc-logfwd with new token pinned via secrets manager 3) verify no more outbound flows 4) perform customer impact sweep.

lia-oncall: do we have runbook steps? I'll start checklist. Steps I'm running now:
- notify on-call SREs (+security, legal, cs)
- block egress (done)
- revoke tokens (pending)
- snapshot artifacts (done)
- customer list (maria->cs-ken)
- public/partner notification hold until legal

sre-alex: immediate commands I'll run now:
```sh
# revoke token
secretsctl revoke svc-logfwd svc-logfwd-327 --reason "suspected exfil"
# deploy new token (rolling restart)
secretsctl create svc-logfwd-rot-20260315 && k8s rollout restart deploy/svc-logfwd
```

maria-security: revoked svc-logfwd-327. New token created svc-logfwd-rot-20260315 and applied to secrets manager.

deploy-bot: rollout status: svc-logfwd-prod: 3/3 updated.

lia-oncall: confirm forwarder now points to internal sink and not external host?

maria-security: verified configs: all forwarders now pointed to internal-loging-sink.redwood.internal; no traces to 54.23.11.9 after 02:20Z.

cs-ken: customer impact: t-98 had ~30 error logs containing stack traces and user email hashes. I will prepare a high-level notification and a follow-up with data details for legal.

legal-paula: please include timeframe, tenant ids, data classes (emails/hashes/stack traces), and mitigation steps. Hold public blog/press until further.

sre-alex: quick ask: rotate any other tokens that had access to the logging sink in the same window? Maria, list services with last-access >= 02:00Z.

maria-security: list: svc-logfwd, telemetry-relay, debug-dump-agent. telemetry-relay shows normal traffic to known sinks; debug-dump-agent had one POST to the IP but that was queued from CI job. I'll revoke debug-dump-agent token as precaution.

lia-oncall: good. action items assigned: infra-ops (edge block) DONE; maria-security (revoke + preserve) DONE; sre-alex (rotate + redeploy) DONE; cs-ken (customer comms draft) IN PROGRESS; legal-paula (notif guidance) IN PROGRESS. We'll keep channel for updates.

maria-security: creating incident ticket INC-2026-321 in tracker and adding artifacts link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-321/artifacts

lia-oncall: thanks all. paging rotation: @sre-alex on primary for next 2h, @lia-oncall fallback. If anything new surfaces, escalate to sec-oncall and execs. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE — mitigations applied, tokens revoked, artifacts preserved, customer assessment underway. Next update in 30m or on-change.
